note: Metadata only. The image files are NOT in git: real students appear in some of them. `npm run media:fetch` downloads each original with a web source into local/media-originals/ and checks the sha256. A `drive:` source is a cropped copy of a photo in the shared Drive: there is nothing to download, so copy and crop it from the synced Drive and the sha256 check confirms it is the same crop. The build writes resized copies into dist/media/. In production the originals live in the Connect media library (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). A `derived:<id>` source is a floor map that ops/room-map.mjs draws from the photo <id>: the build draws it when the original is missing and checks it against the sha256.
